label: late-episode a1->S2 rare transition while unrewarded (D2 and following D1)
explanation: Fires only at D1 and D2 (never GO), only when the reward input is 0 (prev trial unrewarded), and only late in the episode: zero activity before ep_trial 60, rate rising steeply to 5.7x in trials 90-99, so its baseline appears to drift with episode time. All activity is at low model value (bottom third of value). Within that, the core pattern is the a1 -> S2 rare transition: at D2 when S2 is shown after choosing a1 (and the previous trial was unrewarded), and at the next D1 when that rare a1 trial went unrewarded. The top activations are a1->S2 rare D2 steps. Uses only observed variables. Dev: P 0.57, R 0.65, F1 0.61, mass recall 0.74. Requiring ep_trial>=80 raises precision (0.72) but lowers recall. Weaker misses: a2 trials with unrewarded outcomes late in the episode (e.g. a2->S2 common D2 steps) and D1 after any unrewarded a1 trial. False positives: earlier in the 70-99 range and repeated unrewarded rare streaks. Does not fire after rewarded trials, at GO, or before trial 60.
